policies.policyname: meal logging tier boundary
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (nutrition_logs nl
     JOIN clients c ON ((c.client_id = nl.client_id)))
  WHERE ((nl.id = meal_entries.nutrition_log_id) AND (nl.auth_user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (c.auth_user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (lower(c.program) = ANY (ARRAY['ignite'::text, 'phoenix'::text])))))
policies.with_check:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (nutrition_logs nl
     JOIN clients c ON ((c.client_id = nl.client_id)))
  WHERE ((nl.id = meal_entries.nutrition_log_id) AND (nl.auth_user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (c.auth_user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (lower(c.program) = ANY (ARRAY['ignite'::text, 'phoenix'::text])) AND ((meal_entries.entry_source <> 'photo_estimate'::text) OR (lower(c.program) = 'phoenix'::text))))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM foods f
  WHERE (f.id = meal_entries.food_id))) AND ((serving_option_id IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM food_serving_options s
  WHERE ((s.id = meal_entries.serving_option_id) AND (s.food_id = meal_entries.food_id))))) AND ((recurring_food_id IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM recurring_food_patterns r
  WHERE ((r.id = meal_entries.recurring_food_id) AND (r.auth_user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (r.food_id = meal_entries.food_id))))) AND (serving_amount > (0)::numeric) AND (grams > (0)::numeric))

views.name: nutrition_log_remaining
views.definition:
SELECT nl.id AS nutrition_log_id,
    nl.client_id,
    nl.calories - COALESCE(t.calories_eaten, 0::numeric) AS calories_remaining,
    nl.protein - COALESCE(t.protein_eaten_g, 0::numeric) AS protein_remaining_g,
    nl.carbs - COALESCE(t.carbs_eaten_g, 0::numeric) AS carbs_remaining_g,
    nl.fats - COALESCE(t.fat_eaten_g, 0::numeric) AS fat_remaining_g,
    nl.fiber_target_g - COALESCE(t.fiber_eaten_g, 0::numeric) AS fiber_remaining_g,
    nl.sodium_target_mg - COALESCE(t.sodium_eaten_mg, 0::numeric) AS sodium_remaining_mg,
    nl.potassium_target_mg - COALESCE(t.potassium_eaten_mg, 0::numeric) AS potassium_remaining_mg,
    nl.magnesium_target_mg - COALESCE(t.magnesium_eaten_mg, 0::numeric) AS magnesium_remaining_mg,
    nl.calcium_target_mg - COALESCE(t.calcium_eaten_mg, 0::numeric) AS calcium_remaining_mg,
    nl.iron_target_mg - COALESCE(t.iron_eaten_mg, 0::numeric) AS iron_remaining_mg,
    nl.zinc_target_mg - COALESCE(t.zinc_eaten_mg, 0::numeric) AS zinc_remaining_mg,
    nl.selenium_target_mcg - COALESCE(t.selenium_eaten_mcg, 0::numeric) AS selenium_remaining_mcg,
    nl.cholesterol_limit_mg - COALESCE(t.cholesterol_eaten_mg, 0::numeric) AS cholesterol_remaining_mg,
    nl.choline_target_mg - COALESCE(t.choline_eaten_mg, 0::numeric) AS choline_remaining_mg,
    nl.vitamin_a_target_mcg - COALESCE(t.vitamin_a_eaten_mcg, 0::numeric) AS vitamin_a_remaining_mcg,
    nl.vitamin_c_target_mg - COALESCE(t.vitamin_c_eaten_mg, 0::numeric) AS vitamin_c_remaining_mg,
    nl.vitamin_d_target_mcg - COALESCE(t.vitamin_d_eaten_mcg, 0::numeric) AS vitamin_d_remaining_mcg,
    nl.vitamin_e_target_mg - COALESCE(t.vitamin_e_eaten_mg, 0::numeric) AS vitamin_e_remaining_mg,
    nl.vitamin_k_target_mcg - COALESCE(t.vitamin_k_eaten_mcg, 0::numeric) AS vitamin_k_remaining_mcg,
    nl.b1_target_mg - COALESCE(t.b1_eaten_mg, 0::numeric) AS b1_remaining_mg,
    nl.b2_target_mg - COALESCE(t.b2_eaten_mg, 0::numeric) AS b2_remaining_mg,
    nl.b3_target_mg - COALESCE(t.b3_eaten_mg, 0::numeric) AS b3_remaining_mg,
    nl.b5_target_mg - COALESCE(t.b5_eaten_mg, 0::numeric) AS b5_remaining_mg,
    nl.b6_target_mg - COALESCE(t.b6_eaten_mg, 0::numeric) AS b6_remaining_mg,
    nl.b9_target_mcg - COALESCE(t.b9_eaten_mcg, 0::numeric) AS b9_remaining_mcg,
    nl.b12_target_mcg - COALESCE(t.b12_eaten_mcg, 0::numeric) AS b12_remaining_mcg
   FROM nutrition_logs nl
     LEFT JOIN nutrition_log_totals t ON t.nutrition_log_id = nl.id;

views.name: nutrition_log_totals
views.definition:
SELECT me.nutrition_log_id,
    sum(fn.calories * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS calories_eaten,
    sum(fn.protein_g * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS protein_eaten_g,
    sum(fn.carbs_g * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS carbs_eaten_g,
    sum(fn.fat_g * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS fat_eaten_g,
    sum(fn.fiber_g * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS fiber_eaten_g,
    sum(fn.sodium_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS sodium_eaten_mg,
    sum(fn.potassium_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS potassium_eaten_mg,
    sum(fn.magnesium_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS magnesium_eaten_mg,
    sum(fn.calcium_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS calcium_eaten_mg,
    sum(fn.iron_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS iron_eaten_mg,
    sum(fn.zinc_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS zinc_eaten_mg,
    sum(fn.selenium_mcg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS selenium_eaten_mcg,
    sum(fn.cholesterol_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS cholesterol_eaten_mg,
    sum(fn.choline_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS choline_eaten_mg,
    sum(fn.vitamin_a_mcg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS vitamin_a_eaten_mcg,
    sum(fn.vitamin_c_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS vitamin_c_eaten_mg,
    sum(fn.vitamin_d_mcg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS vitamin_d_eaten_mcg,
    sum(fn.vitamin_e_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS vitamin_e_eaten_mg,
    sum(fn.vitamin_k_mcg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS vitamin_k_eaten_mcg,
    sum(fn.b1_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS b1_eaten_mg,
    sum(fn.b2_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS b2_eaten_mg,
    sum(fn.b3_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS b3_eaten_mg,
    sum(fn.b5_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS b5_eaten_mg,
    sum(fn.b6_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS b6_eaten_mg,
    sum(fn.b9_mcg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS b9_eaten_mcg,
    sum(fn.b12_mcg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS b12_eaten_mcg
   FROM meal_entries me
     JOIN food_nutrients fn ON fn.food_id = me.food_id
  WHERE me.entry_state = 'confirmed'::text
  GROUP BY me.nutrition_log_id;

views.name: nutrition_log_totals_by_block
views.definition:
SELECT me.nutrition_log_id,
    COALESCE(me.day_block, 'other'::text) AS day_block,
    sum(fn.calories * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS calories_eaten,
    sum(fn.protein_g * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS protein_eaten_g,
    sum(fn.carbs_g * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS carbs_eaten_g,
    sum(fn.fat_g * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS fat_eaten_g,
    sum(fn.fiber_g * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS fiber_eaten_g,
    sum(fn.sodium_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS sodium_eaten_mg,
    sum(fn.potassium_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS potassium_eaten_mg,
    sum(fn.magnesium_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS magnesium_eaten_mg,
    sum(fn.calcium_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS calcium_eaten_mg,
    sum(fn.iron_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS iron_eaten_mg,
    sum(fn.choline_mg * COALESCE(me.grams, 0::numeric) / 100::numeric) AS choline_eaten_mg
   FROM meal_entries me
     JOIN food_nutrients fn ON fn.food_id = me.food_id
  WHERE me.entry_state = 'confirmed'::text
  GROUP BY me.nutrition_log_id, (COALESCE(me.day_block, 'other'::text));
